fit_reason: Whole 20ft pontoon boat with outboard listed by a private owner in boats by owner.
findings: Dull, streaky and stained aluminum pontoon tubes on both sides, with grayish oxidation and waterline staining
Dull, oxidized aluminum railings and deck edge trim
Faded, chalky-looking side panels with dated graphics along the fence
Dirt and stains on the tan cushions of the front captain's chairs
Cloudy front spot light lenses on the bow
message: Hi Bob, we saw your listing for the Riviera Cruiser pontoon. The new carpet and interior look great, but the pontoon tubes and rails look dull and stained in the photos, and a polish would make them shine for buyers. We do pre-sale details and aluminum polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
